sections.heading: Why electrical faults are common in Dubai properties

children.text: Summer loads are heavy. When every AC unit runs through the afternoon, older circuits and loose connections heat up, and that is when breakers trip and sockets scorch. Villas that have been renovated over the years often have distribution boards that were never re-labelled, which makes faults slow to trace.
We start every visit by testing and isolating the circuit, explain what we found in plain words, and only then agree the repair with you.

sections.heading: If you smell burning
sections.text: Switch off the breaker for that circuit, keep away from the outlet and contact us. Do not keep resetting a breaker that trips again straight away: it is telling you something is wrong.

items.question: Why does my breaker keep tripping?
items.answer: A breaker trips to protect the circuit. The usual causes are too many high-power appliances on one line, a faulty appliance, damp getting into a socket or fitting, or worn wiring. If it trips again straight after you reset it, leave it off and book a fault-finding visit.

items.question: How much does an electrician cost in Dubai?
items.answer: It depends on the job. Replacing a socket or a light fitting costs less than tracing a hidden fault or rewiring a room. Send a photo on WhatsApp and we will explain the expected cost before the visit. You pay after the work is done.

items.question: Can you install light fittings I bought myself?
items.answer: Yes. We fit customer-supplied lights, fans and chandeliers, as long as they are rated for UAE voltage and the ceiling can carry the weight.

sections.heading: Water problems we see in Dubai buildings

children.text: A leak from the flat upstairs, a damp patch spreading across a ceiling, or a water bill that suddenly jumps are the calls we get most. Hot summers are hard on water heaters and on the flexible hoses under basins, which harden and split. Hard water leaves scale in mixers and shower heads and slowly cuts the pressure.
We look for the source first, so you are not paying to fix the same leak twice.

sections.heading: Burst pipe or water through the ceiling?
sections.text: Close the main water valve for your home, switch off electrics near the water, then call or WhatsApp us with a photo and your location.

items.question: Who do I call for a burst pipe at night?
items.answer: Turn off the main water valve for your home first and switch off electrics near the water. Then call or WhatsApp us with a photo and your location. Our emergency repairs page explains how urgent call-outs work.

items.question: How do you find a hidden leak?
items.answer: We first confirm there is a leak by checking the water meter with every tap closed. Then we trace it with moisture readings and pressure tests before opening any wall or floor, which keeps the damage and the repair cost down.

items.question: Can you replace my water heater?
items.answer: Yes. We repair and replace electric water heaters. Send a photo of the label on the old unit so we can bring the right parts.

items.question: How often should I service my AC in Dubai?

children.text: Electrical:
switch off the breaker for the affected circuit, or the main switch if you are unsure, and do not touch scorched fittings.
Water:
close the main valve for your home and switch off electrics in wet areas.

items.question: Is it safe to reset a breaker that keeps tripping?
